text: Day thirty. Let's count. Five hours a day, for thirty days. That's a hundred and fifty hours. Six full days of your life... handed back. That's almost a full week of holidays. And here's the twist. The people in that study? They never gave up their phones. Calls worked. Texts worked. Only the internet was gone. {playful} The phone was never the problem. The endless scroll was. {neutral} And there's more. In a big Stanford study, people who quit Facebook for four weeks... kept using it less, even after they came back. A month doesn't just give you time back. It breaks the habit.
